english:
Who has time to organize their stuff perfectly?
Carry [DECEA3]9 more items (total 9)[-] without being encumbered.
Increases the crafting speed of items from your inventory by 10%.
Your pack has a 5% chance to ignore physical damage when hit.

[DECEA3]On 7d2d 3.3 or newer, remove this mod. Extra items drop in a backpack.[-]

Dein Rucksack hat eine Chance von 5 %, körperlichen Schaden beim Treffer zu ignorieren.
